headline: Gemini 4 Argon rolls out to more users, though some access requires payment
summary: Google rolled out Gemini 4 Argon in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search to more users. One report said the Gemini app and Antigravity rollout is available only to paying users, with developers getting a 50 percent discount on API rates through November.
